actual_checks.name: unconfigured starlight stays unavailable, growth is independent
refunded first purchase cannot grant repeat purchase bonus
excluded artist cannot affect legitimate composite normalization
review and repeat boards require sufficient independent samples and use their stated rates
cold start and newcomer day limits are exact; same scores use a stable person order
referral comes from platform and preserves total, sandbox never allocates
two artists: stable ties, actual sale and growth order; another city/district/category is isolated
actual deduplicated interactions affect each board without changing the original snapshot
opt-out hides the current public projection while preserving frozen scores and re-opt-in restores it
23:59:59.999 Beijing admits only ten votes; midnight resets exactly once, not at UTC midnight
multiple candidates combine official, frozen rank and valid votes; return points excludes that vote without restoring quota
equal complete scores require a separately approved tie decision and issue one award only
city rankings and championship: multi-person facts, Beijing midnight and independent tie review
